newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Dec car sales up 159 pct versus year ago.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Dec car sales up 159 pct versus year ago.

text.p: Vehicle sales in Venezuela rose 159 percent in December to reach 8,548 units, compared to 3,301 over the same period a year ago, Venezuela's Automobile Chamber (Cavenez) said.
The increase marks the second year-on-year rise, with sales also up 13.76 percent from November's level of 7,514 cars, the chamber added.

Taking the year as a whole, however, 1996 saw a 23 percent drop in sales to 61,602 vehicles from 80,391 in 1995. Of these 55,220 were locally manufactured or assembled, down 29 percent from the year before, while the number of imported car sales rose to 6,382 compared to 2,409 in 1995.
Foreign exchange controls were dropped in April 1996 as part of a wider IMF-supported economic reform program.
